svg.title: Act
svg.desc: Command: click <target>, What it does: Click (--button, --count, --modifiers). Waits for any navigation it starts and reports the new page.; Command: fill <target> <value>, What it does: Replace a field's contents, typed as a keyboard would. Works on React-controlled inputs and contenteditables.; Command: type <text>, What it does: Type without clearing first, into --target or the focused element.; Command: press <keys…>, What it does: Keys and chords in order: Enter, Tab, Meta+a, Shift+Tab…; Command: select <target> <values…>, What it does: Choose options in a <select> by value or label.; Command: check, uncheck <target>, What it does: Set a checkbox, radio or switch, then verify it.; Command: hover, focus <target>, What it does: Move the mouse over an element; move keyboard focus to it.; Command: scroll, What it does: Native wheel scrolling: --dy, --dx, --to top or --to bottom, or --target into view.
